item.title: Code review guidelines light the way
item.description:
My humble opinion on the necessity of a check-in process Link to heading

Are you familiar with the situation of getting a code review that is being delayed by your peer reviewer’s nitpicking for filling his code perfection aspirations? Unable to commit due to build server failure? Personal preferences overruled over technical facts?

Let me see your unit tests

item.title: Every code has its audience
item.description:
My humble opinion on who should be included in your code review Link to heading

An educated guess that from time to time, you’ve encountered the question of who should be involved in code reviews. Well, my colleagues and I found ourselves dealing with it, and the arguments about what’s the proper way, go in various directions; Hence I’ve decided to get to the bottom of this critical subject and write my views.
